ivr.welcome: Welcome to FarmBok, your farm record assistant. Please select your preferred language.
ivr.languages: Press 1 for English. Press 2 for Kpelle. Press 3 for Bassa.
ivr.menu.title: Welcome to FarmBok. Please select an option.
ivr.menu.options: Press 1 for farm activities. Press 2 to record a harvest. Press 3 to record a sale. Press 4 for your farm summary. Press 5 for weather. Press 6 for market prices. Press 7 for farm advice. Press 8 for help. Press 9 to end the call.
ivr.after: Press 0 for the main menu. Press 9 to end the call.
ivr.invalid: That key is not on the menu.
ivr.noInput: We did not hear any keys. Please call again. Goodbye.
ivr.goodbye: Thank you for calling FarmBok. Goodbye.
ivr.unknownCaller: This phone number has no FarmBok account yet. To join, dial the FarmBok USSD code or use the FarmBok app, then call again. Goodbye.
ivr.pin: Please type your FarmBok PIN on the phone keys, then press the hash key.
ivr.help: FarmBok keeps your farm records. Choose with the number keys. Your PIN is secret: never say it out loud and never tell anyone. If you forgot your PIN, use the FarmBok app or ask your extension officer.
